ck_job_execution_subject.name: ck_job_execution_subject
ck_job_execution_subject.value: `job_executions`.`subject_type` IN ('user','service','app') AND (`job_executions`.`subject_type` <> 'app' OR (`job_executions`.`app_id` IS NOT NULL AND `job_executions`.`app_id` = `job_executions`.`subject_id`))

ck_job_execution_wait.name: ck_job_execution_wait
ck_job_execution_wait.value: (`job_executions`.`status` <> 'waiting' OR `job_executions`.`wait_reason` IS NOT NULL) AND (`job_executions`.`wait_reason` IS NULL OR `job_executions`.`wait_reason` IN ('approval','human','external','reconcile','resource','budget','previous_execution'))

ck_job_execution_counts.name: ck_job_execution_counts
ck_job_execution_counts.value: `job_executions`.`generation` BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND `job_executions`.`round` > 0 AND `job_executions`.`state_revision` > 0 AND `job_executions`.`cost_usd` >= 0 AND `job_executions`.`reserved_cost_usd` >= 0 AND `job_executions`.`cost_limit_usd` > 0

ck_job_execution_payload.name: ck_job_execution_payload
ck_job_execution_payload.value: (`job_executions`.`input_json` IS NOT NULL AND `job_executions`.`snapshot_json` IS NOT NULL) OR (`job_executions`.`payload_purged_at` IS NOT NULL AND `job_executions`.`status` IN ('succeeded','partial','failed','cancelled','skipped'))
